UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the SoloStrategist OS.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user, matching Firebase Auth UID.

industry.description: The industry the business operates in.

teamSize.description: The size of the user's team.

onboardingComplete.description: Indicates whether the user has completed the onboarding process.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task within the Kanban task board.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this task.

status.description: Current status of the task (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

MetricsData.title: MetricsData
MetricsData.description: Represents aggregated metrics data for a user's business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the metrics data, typically the user's UID.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns these metrics.

conversionRate.description: Conversion rate of leads to customers.

CoachingHistory.title: CoachingHistory
CoachingHistory.description: Represents the history of AI coaching advice given to a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coaching history entry.

userId.description: The UID of the user this history belongs to.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the advice was given.

completionStatus.description: Status of the completion of the advice (e.g., 'Completed', 'In Progress', 'Not Started').

ToolUsageLog.title: ToolUsageLog
ToolUsageLog.description: Logs the usage of various tools and subscriptions by the user to detect potential money leaks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool usage log entry.

userId.description: The UID of the user this log belongs to.

toolName.description: Name of the tool or subscription used.

lastUsed.description: Date and time the tool was last used.

monthlyCost.description: Monthly cost of the tool or subscription.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information. Each document represents a single user's profile and is keyed by their UID.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores tasks for all users. Documents are indexed by userId for queries.

/metrics/{userId}.description: Stores metrics for all users. Documents are keyed by user UID.

/coachingHistory/{historyId}.description: Stores coaching history for all users. Documents are indexed by userId for queries.

/toolUsageLogs/{logId}.description: Stores tool usage logs for all users. Documents are indexed by userId for queries.
